about: A Mitutoyo Surftest SJ-210 roughness tester, modelled from scratch where the placeholder lays it out: the display unit (52.1 x 65.8 x 160 mm) lying screen up, its light-grey upper shell over a dark lower one, the nose chamfered, the backlit colour LCD in a glossy bezel (Ra 0.763 / Rq 0.948 / Rz 4.436 / Rp 2.059 um), the orange accent and the three keys, the ribbed battery lid, the orange logo; the standard drive unit (115 x 23 x 26 mm) on its cable, its detector's skid and stylus resting on a ground reference specimen.
reviewed: 2026-11-05: draft; checked against Mitutoyo's catalogue page and a dealer's photograph, and the placeholder's layout
